claims: Since the review round (0c3e0b3): none of the four lines does, verbs, flow and reread, deleted or left empty, answers a change, and the line then says so, (reread removed); review no longer dates an entry from an empty line.

Since the review round (0c3e0b3): a component's code counts as changed when a file it holds now, or held at the base, differs, so a deleted module, both names of a renamed one, and an edited module moved to another component each ask the component that had it.

Since the owner's ruling (c6d55ca): a component's code also counts as changed when its modules line took a file in or gave one up, whether or not the file was edited. Both components are asked. The same files named another way ask nothing.

Since c6d55ca, changed --strict also exits 1 on a change that only regroups modules: lines, moving a module from one component to another without editing it, until both entries are answered; the plain changed still exits 0.

Part 4 (c6d55ca): a component's reread: line ends with what to look for, 'new public names not in does or verbs: ...' and 'removed public names still in does or verbs: ...'. The names are the public top-level classes and functions of the listed .py files, at the base against now. A name that moved between two files of one component is in neither list. Private names and methods are left out. Eight are shown, then +N more.
A name is 'in does or verbs' when each of its words is there, read as search reads prose (lower case, plural endings dropped, stopwords left out), with underscores and capital humps as word breaks.
The lead about names is a lead and fails nothing. A subsystem's line has none, and an entry that was answered has no line.

F3 (c6d55ca): the field reader is as it was. The lines of an entry that are no field (a key such as owner2 or audit-owner, or no key), up to the next heading, are kept beside its fields, and an edit to them reads 'only other lines edited'. The skill's table of fields now says a field's key is lower-case letters and underscores.

F4 (c6d55ca): the changed row of the command table now says a subsystem's line is for a subsystem with a member whose code changed while none of the subsystem's own four lines was edited, whether or not that member's entry was answered. The site's Reread bullet names the advisory line.
F5 (c6d55ca): entry_commits reads a commit id of 40 or 64 digits, so review dates entries in a repository made with git init --object-format=sha256.

Every page that describes the changed behaviour is updated in this pull request: skills/components/SKILL.md (the changed row of the command table, the table of fields, Before a PR), the two process-phase texts, examples/components-check.yml, docs/components.html and the --strict help string.
plugins/ is what devtools/build_plugins.py generates from the product, at version 0.1.8, which is not released.
Twelve of the tests of 0c3e0b3 fail on 8475b62's script, and fifteen of the tests of c6d55ca fail on 2b22500's script; all of them pass at the head.

The records 002-pr-51-r1.md and 003-rulings.md in .planning/milestones/reread-answers/ claim no plan, spec, review or close that did not happen, every gate they cite is one a reader can rerun at the commit named, and the findings ledger of pr-51-r1 gives each finding's disposition with the commit and the regression test.
